## Correction — the Pi was NEVER patched

A prior session claimed "Pi deployed + verified". **False.** Pi `plugin/transform/` dir
mtime AND **ctime = 2026-10-30 09:42:47**, unchanged since install — immutable proof no
file was ever added or removed there. `request.js` was already `1c1c2089…`; no
`prompt-signature*` existed anywhere under `/home` on the Pi. The port only ever lived on
the local node. Local behavioral evidence stands: e2e 429→200 flip in
`/tmp/opencode/e2e_verify.sh` runs 17788 / 17791.

## Re-apply policy

Use `RESTORE.md` **only after account reinstatement**, and **before** any traffic to
`daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` / `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. Prefer waiting for an
upstream npm release containing PR #623 over re-patching: the cache is ephemeral (lost on
version bump / npm cache GC) and subject to loader self-heal and re-extraction. Re-applying
before reinstatement buys nothing — requests are refused by the account, not the filter.
